title: Assistance for Lifelong Replacement of Aids for Persons with Special Needs
what_it_is: Assistance for Lifelong Replacement of Aids for Persons with Special Needs

sections.label: Assistance for special needs aids
sections.summary: The Minister was asked whether persons with special needs can get lifelong help replacing motorised wheelchairs, cochlear implants and hearing aids; subsidies cover up to 90% of equipment cost.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether the Ministry can further assist persons with special needs who require replacement for aids such as (i) motorised wheelchairs and (ii) cochlear implants and other hearing aids throughout their lives.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: It subsidises up to 90% of equipment cost for persons with disabilities.

sections.label: Fund caps, income criteria, assistance fund
sections.summary: The lifetime cap was doubled from $20,000 to $40,000, income eligibility raised from $1,500 to $1,800, and the Special Assistance Fund supports low-income families' out-of-pocket payments.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Next, the lifetime cap for each person with disability was doubled from $20,000 to $40,000.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Depending on the level of customisation, usage and subsidies received, persons with disabilities can tap on the fund for at least four times for replacement of devices.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Lastly, we raised the per capita monthly income eligibility criteria from $1,500 to $1,800.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We have also worked with the National Council of Social Service to provide additional funding to better support low-income families with their out-of-pocket payments for the devices through the Special Assistance Fund.

sections.label: Beneficiaries and take-up rate increase
sections.summary: Close to 1,200 persons with disabilities benefited, a more than seven-fold rise from 15 beneficiaries a month in 2014 to about 110 a month after the enhancements.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Since the enhancements, close to 1,200 persons with disabilities have benefited from the fund.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: This is more than a seven-fold increase in the take-up rate from 15 beneficiaries a month in 2014 prior to the enhancement, to about 110 beneficiaries a month after the enhancements.

sections.label: Noting Member's suggestions
sections.summary: The Ministry will take note of the Member's suggestions.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Indeed, we will take note of the Member's suggestions.
